test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ______ was Chef de Mission of the Indian contingent at the 2018 Asian Games.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brij Bhushan Saran Singh.**__

 
• Wrestling Federation of India president** Brij Bhushan Saran Singh** is set to be named the **Chef de Mission of the Asian Games-bound Indian contingent.**
 
• The IOA has announced a** 524-member contingent of athletes for the August 18-September 2 Asian Games in Indonesia.**
